reproducibility.transport_pattern: python ssh_remote.py command <shell-quoted Nimbus Python -c code> --timeout 120
reproducibility.executed_operation_description: Read-only SSH execution of a Python script using Nimbus Python; recomputed four file SHA-256 values and compared saved metadata; read key manifest and completion record; independently selected OOF thresholds from the saved grid; printed filtered split and macro metrics.
reproducibility.equivalent_reproduction_code:
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
R=Path('/mnt/disk3/mIHC/mif_marker_positivity_20261022/analyses/cd8_e1_e4_stability_20261023')
def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open('rb') as f:
        for b in iter(lambda:f.read(8*1024*1024),b''): h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()
f=json.loads((R/'THRESHOLDS_FROZEN.json').read_text())
t=json.loads((R/'TRAINING_RUN.json').read_text())
e=json.loads((R/'results/EVALUATION_COMPLETE.json').read_text())
for file,value in [('E1_E4_PROTOCOL.json',f['protocol_sha256']),('keys/key_manifest.csv',t['keys_sha256']),('THRESHOLDS_FROZEN.json',e['threshold_freeze_sha256']),('audit/cells.parquet',t['cells_sha256'])]:
    actual=sha(R/file)
    print(file,actual,value,actual==value)
    assert actual==value
grid=pd.read_csv(R/'results/OOF_threshold_grid.csv')
for model,g in grid.groupby('model'):
    best=g[g.mean_WSI_F1 >= g.mean_WSI_F1.max()-1e-15].copy()
    best['distance']=(best.grid_integer-50).abs()
    selected=best.sort_values(['distance','grid_integer'],ascending=[True,False]).iloc[0]
    assert abs(float(selected.threshold)-f['thresholds'][model])<1e-12
    print(model,len(g),selected.threshold,selected.mean_WSI_F1)
print(pd.read_csv(R/'keys/key_manifest.csv').to_json(orient='records'))
print((R/'results/FINAL_VALIDATION.json').read_text())
reproducibility.reproduction_code_note: This is a saved equivalent of the completed checks, not a claim that this literal formatting was the original shell command. It contains no credentials.

calibration_boundary.unit: 3 training WSIs, 3 reconstructed internal WSIs, 42 independent external cores
calibration_boundary.eligible_instances: At least 5 finite raw pixels, independently of labels and geometry QC.
calibration_boundary.interpretation: Per-image unsupervised target adaptation, not a mapping fitted exclusively on the training distribution.
calibration_boundary.GMM: Existing per-unit GMM also uses that unit's unlabelled observations; its threshold remains strict score > 0.5 in both comparison panels.

ranking_scope.primary_metric: Pooled external-cell F1, fixed strict score > 0.5
ranking_scope.supplemental_metric: Pooled external-cell F1 at global training-OOF-selected thresholds

limitations_not_newly_verified: Patient-level disjointness was not newly verified: existing official image/WSI/core splits and explicit cell keys do not establish unique independent patients. Do not treat 42 cores as 42 independent patients.

Cross-split same-source crops, shared tissue regions or near-duplicate images were not newly exhaustively checked by image content/coordinates in this audit. Canonical keys and file hashes do not prove absence of homologous image content.

This source-and-artifact audit cannot prove absence of all historical human decisions informed by external performance. These external labels have already been evaluated in prior project rounds; the present ranking is retrospective.

Four SHA agreements establish current file/run consistency, not cryptographic proof of historical wall-clock ordering. Freeze-before-inference is supported by inspected control flow and saved metadata.
Threshold reselection here uses the saved OOF grid; it does not independently retrain models or regenerate every OOF probability. The inspected source shows training-only input to selection.
OOF scores used both to select and report the chosen threshold produce a development fitting value, not an unbiased estimate of the threshold-selection procedure.
E1-E4 each use one random seed. Their small F1 differences are descriptive; no robustness or significance claim follows.
TMA2 remains worse than GMM despite overall external gains. Pooled rankings do not imply improvement in every source.

other_model_inclusion.TabM: Completed A/B/C used raw features plus training-fitted preprocessing; not the E1 per-image L/U calibration. Do not relabel them as completed common-calibration counterparts.
other_model_inclusion.Nimbus: Official image preprocessing differs from E1 common calibration; pretrained-source independence and model-selection boundaries require separate discussion. Do not combine it into this controlled E1-E4 calibrated ablation ranking.
other_model_inclusion.probability_calibration: No additional supervised probability calibrator is being claimed for any method in this ranking.
